narrative: Gaunt's roll held open on the desk by the inkhorn. Cue-words ranged right after a long rule, in a fair secretary that is not yours. Gib asleep on the grey cloth over the chronicle. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the roll at the desk.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Slept on the cloth over the Holinshed.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
